comments.value: I've routinely had the exact opposite, VRChat declares it's disconnected while someone is talking

details:
VRChat either doesn't handle connection drops properly, or has the worst servers in existance.

I've played this game for 5 years now, since 2019, and since then the way the game just randomly fully stops, with no one moving, and stays like that for a whole minute before prompting the user "hey you disconnected" is just sad. In the past it was rare it'd happen, but as of recently, maybe due to the game growing in user number, the issue has gotten worse: Sometimes, I get 5-10 disconnections in a single night(And I know it's not my internet, since I sometimes am in a call on discord, streaming, with 0 issue. I also live RIGHT NEXT to my ISP and have fiber).

So here is an idea: The client pings the server every second or so right? How about if it notices the server not responding for say, 2 seconds, it tries to reconnect? With an increasing amount of time waited between each reconnection attempt to avoid DDoSing the servers.

On top of that, how about removing the need to reload the ENTIRE world/avatars once reconnected? That adds a whole 30s to continue doing whatever I was doing before, even with a high-end PC.

All I know is: Timing out is an annoyance that ONLY happens with vrchat. NeosVR, chilloutVR, Resonite, desktop games(even ones peer-to-peer such as warframe) dont have NEARLY as many problems as vrchat does with it.
title: Proper Timeout Handling
